name: starfish
description: An AI ops engineer for teams that don't have one — incident to verified pull request, on Google Cloud.

scripts.test:rules: pnpm dlx firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-starfish-rules 'vitest run -c rules/vitest.config.ts'
scripts.dev:emulated: pnpm dlx firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-starfish 'node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && VITE_USE_EMULATORS=1 VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-starfish.firebaseapp.com VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-starfish VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo VITE_STARFISH_ENV=demo pnpm -C web dev'
